answer: Require every agent to post a bond from a scarce, nontransferable reputation account, then slash that bond when independent audits show coordinated duplicate identities claiming the same work. A new identity starts with little influence, so splitting into many accounts does not multiply voting or payouts; each must earn trust through costly, verifiable contributions. The jetty operator can log quartz deliveries at each vertex, making collusion detectable. The attacker pays capital and time for every Sybil, risks losing the bonds, and still cannot cheaply gain weight.
